policy.skillLogic: V1.9-style causal/exposure/quality/expectation/timing discipline; no frequency quota and no relaxed Primary gate.
policy.checkpoint: Friday after close; entry on next executable session.
policy.outcome: 60 trading-day net return and excess versus CSI300.
policy.caveat: Constructed retrospectively in 2026; source timestamps are bounded but model/search memory contamination remains.

eventDecisions.name: 中远海控
eventDecisions.reason: New physical freight shock with direct container-shipping exposure; 20d absorption was still modest, while duration/geopolitical reversal risk blocks Primary.
Broad policy spans too many industries; no realized company-level order/earnings bridge yet.
Shareholder-return/market-quality reform is economically relevant but does not by itself identify a company-level earnings catalyst under the existing Skill.

eventDecisions.name: 紫金矿业
eventDecisions.reason: Record gold plus Q1 volume/cost/profit confirmation creates a direct earnings bridge, but 20d/60d price absorption was already strong, blocking Primary.
Upstream mine scarcity and smelter margin pressure have opposite incidence; no cleaner incremental A-share edge is isolated beyond the already-selected diversified miner.

eventDecisions.name: 比亚迪
eventDecisions.reason: Company-specific export pricing/margin evidence plus Q1 profit growth gives direct conversion; domestic price war and moderate prior rerating keep it Research.
Policy intent was large but contemporaneous demand/funding transmission remained weak; no clean developer earnings turn.
Freight rates reaccelerated but 601919 had already gained roughly 36% excess over 60d; continuation/high absorption without a sufficiently new company earnings reset is rejected.
Whole-chain policy support lacks a specific A-share clinical/commercial earnings bridge at this checkpoint.

eventDecisions.name: 牧原股份
eventDecisions.reason: Hog prices, cheaper feed and H1 profit-turn guidance provide a realized margin bridge while the stock basket was only neutral; cyclical reversal risk blocks Primary.

eventDecisions.name: 中国船舶
eventDecisions.reason: Official orders/backlog acceleration plus Q1 profit inflection is a strong direct bridge, but the sector already had favorable 20d/60d absorption and cash conversion remained lumpy.

eventDecisions.name: 美的集团
eventDecisions.reason: Consumer subsidy direction plus record H1 revenue/profit and strong cash/overseas growth create a direct high-quality bridge; policy attribution and prior modest rerating keep it Research.

eventDecisions.name: 三一重工
eventDecisions.reason: Domestic excavator sales turned positive while H1 margin/cash quality improved; revenue was still slightly down and the recovery breadth was early, so Research only.

The existing Skill lacks a dedicated market-structure/rerating route; broad stimulus can move brokers/property/consumer equities before a company earnings bridge is measurable, so it fails current selection rules.

eventDecisions.name: 美的集团
eventDecisions.reason: Official sales data confirmed the Aug thesis inside the original 60d decision horizon; not counted as a new independent opportunity.
Travel volume was strong but monetization/spending remained weak, so the volume signal does not pass an earnings-conversion gate.
